content: ffmpeg subtitles filter (libass): options filename, original_size, fontsdir, alpha, charenc, force_style, shaping (auto/simple/complex). On Android there are no system fonts/fontconfig — must pass fontsdir to bundled fonts and matching Fontname, else no glyphs render silently. Filtergraph multi-level escaping applies to paths (colons/quotes in filter args). complex shaping needed for Arabic; karaoke \K tags + RTL is fragile in libass.
